Modi, Xi Discuss India's Concerns in China Talks, MEA Reports

Prime Minister Narendra Modi raised India's concerns and stressed the need for sensitivity to core issues during talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping, according to the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA). The MEA stated that India-China relations must adhere to 'three mutuals'. The specific nature of India's concerns and the details of the 'three mutuals' were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage.
